description:
# raw2features Snakemake workflow

Runs [raw2features](https://github.com/CraigMyles/raw2features) over a cohort of OME-Zarr
whole-slide images. Per slide: `raw2features embed` → `<id>.embeddings.zarr` → `validate-store`,
with an optional SpatialData export. Slides are discovered as `*.ome.zarr` in `slide_dir`.

This workflow (v1.0.0) pins raw2features 0.2.1. raw2features is MIT-licensed and copyright
Craig Myles; see [CITATION.cff](CITATION.cff) for how to cite both.

## Quick start

```bash
pip install snakemake "raw2features[zarr,image,torch,models]==0.2.1"

# smoke test on a generated synthetic slide (CPU)
mkdir -p test_data && raw2features sample test_data/sample.ome.zarr
snakemake --cores 2 --configfile config/test.yaml

# your cohort
snakemake --cores 8 --config slide_dir=/data/slides out_dir=/data/emb qc=grandqc
```

`raw2features` must be on the `PATH` of the shell Snakemake spawns (activate your venv first), or
set `raw2features_cmd` to its full path. A `command not found` in
`<out_dir>/logs/<slide>.embed.log` means this.

Defaults are in [config/config.yaml](config/config.yaml). Re-running resumes missing slides. For Slurm use `snakemake-executor-plugin-slurm` (`--executor slurm`).

## Running with Docker

Snakemake itself only supports Apptainer/Singularity containers, so to use Docker, make the
command a `docker run` of the pinned image (tested):

```bash
snakemake --cores 2 --configfile config/test.yaml \
  --config raw2features_cmd="docker run --rm -u $(id -u):$(id -g) -e HOME=$PWD/.cache -v $PWD:$PWD -w $PWD ghcr.io/pschrempf/raw2features:0.2.1 raw2features"
```

Add `-v <dir>:<dir>` for data outside the working directory and `--gpus all` for GPUs.

## Running with Apptainer/Singularity

`container` in `config/config.yaml` points at the same image; Snakemake uses it when container
support is switched on:

```bash
snakemake --cores 8 --software-deployment-method apptainer   # Snakemake >= 8
snakemake --cores 8 --use-singularity                         # Snakemake 7 (tested)
```

## Building the image

[Dockerfile](Dockerfile) installs a pinned raw2features release. Keep the image tag equal to
that version:

```bash
docker build --build-arg R2F_VERSION=0.2.1 -t ghcr.io/pschrempf/raw2features:0.2.1 .
docker push ghcr.io/pschrempf/raw2features:0.2.1
```
